title: Carnapped vehicle recovered in Bulacan hours after report
summary: A missing multi‑purpose vehicle was recovered in Marilao, Bulacan hours after being reported to the Quezon City Police District (QCPD) on Sept. 3. The red metallic 2025 Mitsubishi Xpander was logged…
